listings.title: GoldenTree Presents ~ A Collector's Eye: Original Art, Folk Art, Pop Surrealism & Holiday Treasures
listings.description: Discover an eclectic and thoughtfully curated collection of original artwork, festive holiday decorations, and distinctive home décor, all from the personal collection of a single owner with a passion for art, creativity, and unique design. This auction features an impressive selection of original paintings and artwork by James Bonstow, Liana Steinmetz, Jordan Nichole, EMYO, Christy Kinard, Diana Card, Seung Lee, Jennifer Lanne, and Laurie Messeroll, among others. The collection showcases a wonderful mix of artistic styles, including contemporary folk art, whimsical and expressive works, and pop surrealism, including the imaginative, dreamlike paintings of Laurie Messeroll. From colorful, playful compositions to more traditional folk-inspired pieces, the artwork reflects a collector drawn to originality, personality, and visual storytelling. Beyond the art, discover a charming assortment of Christmas and seasonal décor from Crate & Barrel, Restoration Hardware, and other quality brands. The auction also includes handcrafted needlepoint samplers, decorative accents, and an assortment of unique holiday and household treasures. Whether you're a collector of original art, drawn to the charm of folk art and pop surrealism, or searching for distinctive holiday decorations and home accessories, this auction offers a wonderful opportunity to acquire pieces from a carefully assembled private collection. An Eclectic Collection. Original Art. Whimsical Finds. Timeless Treasures. ________________________________________________________________________ PICK UP SATURDAY, 12/5/2026 - ASHLEY RD, NEWTOWN PA. THE ADDRESS WILL BE IN THE WINNING INVOICE. Collectors and decor enthusiasts will appreciate the standout selection of contemporary and vintage art glass, including deep amber Murano-style knot paperweights, hand-blown iridescent vases, a spherical amber swirl vase, and a tall trumpet vase with a wired armature. The home is also adorned with beautiful wall art, such as a large abstract botanical canvas, modern floral prints, and signed impasto acrylic paintings. In addition to fine home accents, this sale includes charming coastal-themed bathroom accessories, quality linens, and practical storage and household utility items. Functional highlights feature a Werner aluminum stepladder, a vintage wooden stepladder, long-handled lawn tools, an adjustable metal clothing rack, and a variety of cleaning supplies and packing materials. Join us for this well-rounded event to discover unique decorative pieces and essential items for your home.

listings.title: Cherry Hill Estate Sale: Vintage Video Games, Tools, Bicycles & Toys
listings.description: B&B Estate Sales invites you to an exceptional sale in Cherry Hill, NJ, featuring an impressive mix of vintage collectibles, tools, gaming, and outdoor gear. Highlights include an Authentic Models silver Indianapolis Speedway race car in its original display box, a vintage Sega Genesis Model 2 console bundle with controllers and games, a Tyco RC Mini Xtreme Cycle new in box, and a brass trombone in its hardshell case. Collectors and hobbyists will also find a variety of vintage model cars, a Guitar Hero controller, board games, and a Sylvania CRT TV/VCR/DVD combo unit. For outdoor enthusiasts and DIYers, this sale offers a large selection of bicycles, including cruiser and BMX models from brands like Mongoose, Next, and Magna. The workshop and garage are fully stocked with vintage Craftsman metal toolboxes, power tools, hand tools, jack stands, a battery charger, an Oreck XL air purifier, yard tools, plastic coolers, and automotive supplies. Cash and credit card payments are accepted via Square for your convenience. We look forward to seeing you there!
